# Contribution Role

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ContributionRole`](gmeow-ContributionRole.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ContributionRole>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The role an agent played in contributing to a creative work — a VALUE vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Author, editor, translator, illustrator, narrator, composer, performer, director, photographer, and cover-artist are examples; the set is open.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ContributionRole`](gmeow-ContributionRole.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the role of a credit — referenced by [`gmeow:contributionRole`](../properties/gmeow-contributionRole.md) inside a [`Contribution`](gmeow-Contribution.md), spanning creative, CRediT research, and software roles.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding roles as [`Contribution`](gmeow-Contribution.md) subclasses or as bespoke properties ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid using it for the weight of a credit (that is [`gmeow:ContributionDegree`](gmeow-ContributionDegree.md)).

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:ContributionRole`](gmeow-ContributionRole.md) individual from [`gmeow:contributionRole`](../properties/gmeow-contributionRole.md); extend with new role individuals (not subclasses) when a domain needs one.

### Examples

- [`gmeow:roleTranslator`](../individuals/gmeow-roleTranslator.md) a [`gmeow:ContributionRole`](gmeow-ContributionRole.md).
